summary: A Yes vote amends the City of Riverbank General Plan to require majority voter approval before the city may authorize converting agricultural land or open space west of the city limits to urban uses.

housing.text: A Yes vote would require majority voter approval before the City Council could authorize or facilitate urban development on agricultural or open space lands west of the city limits.
housing.quote: The measure, if adopted by a ‘yes’ vote, would then require that a “majority of city voters approve at an election any decision of the Riverbank City Council that would authorize or facilitate development of urban uses on agricultural or open space lands located west of the current city limits of the City of Riverbank.”

housing.text: A No vote would not impose this voter-approval requirement on such development decisions.
